title: OpenAI VP of research Jerry Tworek is leaving, sources say after OpenAI sided with Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki in a dispute over its research direction (Maxwell Zeff/Wired)
summary: Maxwell Zeff / Wired: OpenAI VP of research Jerry Tworek is leaving, sources say after OpenAI sided with Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki in a dispute over its research direction — Tech companies are calling AI the next platform. But some developers are reluctant to let AI agents stand between them and their users.
